rubric.why: Loss of electrons and gain of oxygen are standard definitions of oxidation.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating either that oxidation is loss of electrons or that it is gain of oxygen.

rubric.why: The equation shows magnesium reacting with oxygen to form magnesium oxide.
rubric.description: Gives a valid example of oxidation.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct example, such as magnesium reacting with oxygen to form magnesium oxide.

modelAnswer: Oxidation is the loss of electrons by an atom or ion; it can also be described as the gain of oxygen.
For example: 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO. Magnesium is oxidized by oxygen.

rubric.why: A molecule is made of atoms bonded together and acting as a unit.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for defining a molecule as a group of two or more chemically bonded atoms behaving as a unit.

rubric.why: A monatomic molecule has one atom; helium is a suitable example.
rubric.description: Describes a monatomic molecule and gives an example.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the type and giving a suitable example.

rubric.why: A diatomic molecule contains two atoms; hydrogen and oxygen are suitable examples.
rubric.description: Describes a diatomic molecule and gives an example.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the type and giving a suitable example.

rubric.why: A triatomic molecule contains three atoms; ozone and water are suitable examples.
rubric.description: Describes a triatomic molecule and gives an example.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the type and giving a suitable example.

rubric.why: A polyatomic molecule contains more than three atoms; phosphorus and sulphur are suitable examples.
rubric.description: Describes a polyatomic molecule and gives an example.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming the type and giving a suitable example.

modelAnswer: A molecule is a group of two or more atoms chemically bonded together and behaving as a single unit.
A monatomic molecule contains one atom, e.g. He.
A diatomic molecule contains two atoms, e.g. H₂.
A triatomic molecule contains three atoms, e.g. O₃.
A polyatomic molecule contains more than three atoms, e.g. P₄ or S₈.
